notes: DISCOVERED during the new-home-sales-2026-09-24 initial-research adjacency sweep (2026-09-06). This calendar tracks the November edition of the HMI and no earlier one, so the September edition — which leads BOTH housing-starts-2026-09-17 (the next morning) and this proposer (eight days later) on the same August/September reference window — has no entry. Two things make it worth a lane rather than a footnote. First, 2026-09-16 is the September FOMC decision day (fomc-2026-09-16, tracked), so the builder-sentiment read lands on the loudest session of its own corridor and any tape reaction to it is unattributable by construction — the same stacked-event problem the new-home-sales-2026-10-27 lane measured on FOMC-eve, one rung worse. Second, the HMI is a private survey and publishes through a federal funding lapse where Census does not, which is exactly the property that makes it the surviving housing read in the branch cr-expiry-2026-12-11 opens; the tracked nahb-hmi-2026-11-17 entry cannot carry that observation for September. Impact LOW and symbols empty on the same measured grounds as the sibling housing entries — no macro-keyed house playbook (0 hits, re-grepped 2026-09-06) and no instrument attaches — and whoever researches it should re-derive both rather than inherit them.
